question: Is first-line osimertinib superior to standard first-generation EGFR-TKIs in patients with advanced EGFR-mutant NSCLC?
claim: Osimertinib leads to significantly longer progression-free survival (18.9 months vs. 10.2 months) compared to standard EGFR-TKIs in untreated advanced EGFR-mutated NSCLC.
source_title: Osimertinib in Untreated EGFR-Mutated Advanced Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer.
quoted_or_source_note: The median progression-free survival was significantly longer with osimertinib than with standard EGFR-TKIs (18.9 months vs. 10.2 months; hazard ratio for disease progression or death, 0.46; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.37 to 0.57; P<0.001).
agent_summary: FLAURA trial established superior PFS of osimertinib over standard first-generation EGFR-TKIs in treatment-naive EGFR-mutant advanced NSCLC.

question: Does adding chemotherapy to first-line osimertinib improve PFS in patients with advanced EGFR-mutant NSCLC?
drug: osimertinib, pemetrexed plus cisplatin or carboplatin
claim: Adding chemotherapy (pemetrexed-plus-platinum) to first-line osimertinib significantly prolongs progression-free survival compared to osimertinib monotherapy in advanced EGFR-mutant NSCLC.
source_title: Osimertinib with or without Chemotherapy in
quoted_or_source_note: Investigator-assessed progression-free survival was significantly longer in the osimertinib-chemotherapy group than in the osimertinib group (hazard ratio for disease progression or death, 0.62; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.49 to 0.79; P<0.001).
agent_summary: FLAURA2 trial demonstrated that combining osimertinib with pemetrexed-plus-platinum chemotherapy significantly improves PFS compared with osimertinib alone in untreated EGFR-mutant advanced NSCLC.

question: Does adjuvant osimertinib improve disease-free survival in patients with resected stage IB-IIIA EGFR-mutant NSCLC?
claim: Adjuvant osimertinib provides a significant disease-free survival benefit over placebo in patients with completely resected stage IB-IIIA EGFR-mutated NSCLC.
source_title: Adjuvant Osimertinib for Resected EGFR-Mutated Stage IB-IIIA Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer: Updated Results From the Phase III Randomized ADAURA Trial.
quoted_or_source_note: In the overall population, DFS HR was 0.27 (95% CI, 0.21 to 0.34); 4-year DFS rate was 73% (osimertinib) and 38% (placebo).
agent_summary: ADAURA updated results confirmed that adjuvant osimertinib significantly prolongs DFS compared to placebo in stage IB-IIIA resected EGFR-mutant NSCLC.

question: Is osimertinib effective after chemoradiotherapy in patients with unresectable stage III EGFR-mutant NSCLC?
claim: Osimertinib significantly prolongs progression-free survival compared to placebo in patients with unresectable stage III EGFR-mutated NSCLC who did not progress during or after chemoradiotherapy.
source_title: Osimertinib after Chemoradiotherapy in Stage III
quoted_or_source_note: Osimertinib resulted in a significant progression-free survival benefit as compared with placebo: the median progression-free survival was 39.1 months with osimertinib versus 5.6 months with placebo, with a hazard ratio for disease progression or death of 0.16 (95% confidence interval [CI], 0.10 to 0.24; P<0.001).
agent_summary: LAURA trial showed that consolidation osimertinib after chemoradiotherapy significantly prolonged PFS (39.1 vs 5.6 months) in unresectable stage III EGFR-mutated NSCLC.

question: Is amivantamab plus chemotherapy effective in patients with EGFR-mutated advanced NSCLC after disease progression on osimertinib?
disease: EGFR-mutated advanced NSCLC after osimertinib progression
claim: Amivantamab plus chemotherapy significantly prolongs progression-free survival compared to chemotherapy alone in patients with EGFR-mutated advanced NSCLC after progression on osimertinib.
source_title: Amivantamab plus chemotherapy with and without lazertinib in EGFR-mutant advanced NSCLC after disease progression on osimertinib: primary results from the phase III MARIPOSA-2 study.
quoted_or_source_note: PFS was significantly longer for amivantamab-chemotherapy and amivantamab-lazertinib-chemotherapy versus chemotherapy [hazard ratio (HR) for disease progression or death 0.48 and 0.44, respectively; P < 0.001 for both; median of 6.3 and 8.3 versus 4.2 months, respectively].
agent_summary: MARIPOSA-2 trial demonstrated that adding amivantamab to carboplatin-pemetrexed chemotherapy significantly prolonged PFS (6.3 months vs 4.2 months) compared to chemotherapy alone in patients with EGFR-mutant advanced NSCLC after progression on osimertinib.

question: Is lorlatinib superior to crizotinib in previously untreated advanced ALK-positive NSCLC (initial results)?
claim: First-line lorlatinib treatment leads to significantly higher 12-month progression-free survival (78% vs 39%, HR 0.28) compared to crizotinib in patients with advanced ALK-positive NSCLC.
source_title: First-Line Lorlatinib or Crizotinib in Advanced
quoted_or_source_note: The percentage of patients who were alive without disease progression at 12 months was 78% (95% confidence interval [CI], 70 to 84) in the lorlatinib group and 39% (95% CI, 30 to 48) in the crizotinib group (hazard ratio for disease progression or death, 0.28; 95% CI, 0.19 to 0.41; P<0.001).
agent_summary: Initial CROWN trial results showed that first-line lorlatinib has superior PFS and intracranial efficacy compared to crizotinib in advanced ALK-positive NSCLC.

question: Is lorlatinib superior to crizotinib in previously untreated advanced ALK-positive NSCLC (5-year follow-up)?
claim: Long-term 5-year follow-up confirms that first-line lorlatinib maintains superior progression-free survival (median PFS not reached vs 9.1 months, HR 0.19) compared to crizotinib in advanced ALK-positive NSCLC.
source_title: Lorlatinib Versus Crizotinib in Patients With Advanced
quoted_or_source_note: With a median follow-up for PFS of 60.2 and 55.1 months, respectively, median PFS was not reached (NR [95% CI, 64.3 to NR]) with lorlatinib and 9.1 months (95% CI, 7.4 to 10.9) with crizotinib (hazard ratio [HR], 0.19 [95% CI, 0.13 to 0.27]).
agent_summary: 5-year follow-up from CROWN trial confirms lorlatinib's long-term efficacy with a median PFS not reached, representing the longest reported PFS for single-agent targeted treatment in advanced NSCLC.

question: Is alectinib superior to crizotinib in untreated advanced ALK-positive NSCLC?
claim: Alectinib shows superior progression-free survival and lower toxicity compared to crizotinib in patients with previously untreated advanced ALK-positive NSCLC.
source_title: Alectinib versus Crizotinib in Untreated ALK-Positive Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer.
quoted_or_source_note: The rate of investigator-assessed progression-free survival was significantly higher with alectinib than with crizotinib (12-month event-free survival rate, 68.4% ... vs. 48.7% ... hazard ratio for disease progression or death, 0.47 [95% CI, 0.34 to 0.65]; P<0.001); the median progression-free survival with alectinib was not reached.
agent_summary: ALEX phase III trial demonstrated that first-line alectinib provides superior PFS and lower rates of grade 3-5 adverse events compared with crizotinib in advanced ALK-positive NSCLC.

question: Does baseline TP53 mutation status predict progression-free survival (PFS) outcomes in patients with advanced ALK-positive NSCLC?
claim: Baseline TP53 mutation in plasma cell-free DNA is associated with poor progression-free survival in patients with advanced ALK-positive NSCLC.
source_title: Brigatinib Versus Crizotinib in ALK Inhibitor-Naive Advanced ALK-Positive NSCLC: Final Results of Phase 3 ALTA-1L Trial.
quoted_or_source_note: Detectable baseline EML4-ALK fusion variant 3 and TP53 mutation in plasma were associated with poor PFS.
agent_summary: Final analysis of the ALTA-1L trial indicates that baseline TP53 mutation is a negative prognostic marker associated with poorer PFS in ALK-positive advanced NSCLC.

question: Does first-line amivantamab-lazertinib improve PFS compared to osimertinib in EGFR-mutant advanced NSCLC patients with TP53 co-mutations?
claim: Amivantamab plus lazertinib significantly improves progression-free survival compared to osimertinib monotherapy in first-line EGFR-mutant advanced NSCLC patients with TP53 co-mutations.
study_type: Secondary analysis of Phase III RCT
source_title: Amivantamab plus lazertinib versus osimertinib in first-line EGFR-mutant advanced non-small-cell lung cancer with biomarkers of high-risk disease: a secondary analysis from MARIPOSA.
quoted_or_source_note: Amivantamab-lazertinib improved median PFS (mPFS) versus osimertinib for patients with TP53 co-mutations {18.2 versus 12.9 months; HR 0.65 [95% confidence interval (CI) 0.48-0.87]; P = 0.003}
agent_summary: MARIPOSA secondary analysis showed that first-line amivantamab-lazertinib significantly prolonged PFS compared to osimertinib monotherapy in the high-risk subgroup of patients with EGFR-mutated advanced NSCLC and TP53 co-mutations.

question: Are EGFR and TP53 mutations clonal in early-stage NSCLC?
claim: Driver mutations in EGFR and TP53 are almost always clonal in early-stage non-small-cell lung cancer.
source_title: Tracking the Evolution of Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer.
quoted_or_source_note: Driver mutations in EGFR, MET, BRAF, and TP53 were almost always clonal.
agent_summary: TRACERx prospective cohort study established that driver mutations in EGFR and TP53 are clonal events arising early in the evolutionary history of NSCLC.

question: Is pemetrexed-plus-platinum chemotherapy effective in patients with advanced NSCLC without EGFR or ALK alterations?
claim: Pemetrexed-plus-platinum chemotherapy is a standard first-line treatment option for patients with metastatic nonsquamous NSCLC without EGFR/ALK alterations.
source_title: Pembrolizumab Plus Pemetrexed and Platinum in Nonsquamous Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer: 5-Year Outcomes From the Phase 3 KEYNOTE-189 Study.
quoted_or_source_note: These data continue to support pembrolizumab plus pemetrexed-platinum as a standard of care in previously untreated metastatic non-small-cell lung cancer without EGFR/ALK alterations.
agent_summary: KEYNOTE-189 5-year follow-up confirms that pemetrexed-plus-platinum chemotherapy (plus placebo) yielded a 5-year OS rate of 11.3%, serving as the standard chemotherapy backbone for patients without EGFR/ALK alterations.

question: What is the impact of TP53 mutations on treatment outcomes with osimertinib monotherapy in first-line EGFR-mutant advanced NSCLC?
claim: In EGFR-mutant advanced NSCLC, patients with TP53 co-mutations have a poor prognosis during first-line treatment with osimertinib monotherapy.
study_type: Secondary analysis of Phase III RCT
source_title: Amivantamab plus lazertinib versus osimertinib in first-line EGFR-mutant advanced non-small-cell lung cancer with biomarkers of high-risk disease: a secondary analysis from MARIPOSA.
quoted_or_source_note: Patients with TP53 co-mutations, detectable circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA), baseline liver metastases, and those without ctDNA clearance on treatment have poor prognoses.
agent_summary: MARIPOSA secondary analysis confirms that patients with TP53 co-mutations have poorer prognosis (shorter PFS) when treated with first-line osimertinib monotherapy.

question: Does TP53 mutation directly cause resistance to osimertinib by upregulating specific alternative bypass pathways in NSCLC?
claim: TP53 mutations directly upregulate alternative bypass pathway signaling (such as MET or HER2) to mediate acquired resistance to osimertinib in EGFR-mutant NSCLC.
agent_summary: This represents a plausible biological mechanism of bypass pathway activation in TP53-mutated, EGFR-mutant NSCLC under TKI pressure, but it is not directly evaluated or reported in the clinical abstracts in our inventory.

question: Is crizotinib superior to osimertinib in patients with advanced NSCLC harboring both EGFR mutations and ALK rearrangements?
claim: In patients with rare double-driver EGFR-mutant and ALK-rearranged advanced NSCLC, crizotinib is superior to osimertinib.
agent_summary: No literature comparing crizotinib and osimertinib in patients with concurrent EGFR mutations and ALK rearrangements was found. This double-driver population is extremely rare.
